entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, I think I need to return something? I'm just so confused by the website. I have this helmet here, and I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't really know. It's... the color, I guess. My son bought it for me but it's not what I wanted. I never even took it out of its packaging, the box is unopened. I tried to look online but it was all very overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help sort this out for you. I'm pulling up your account now. One moment while I review the policy for your order.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I see the Aero Road Helmet was delivered 61 days ago. According to our policy, you have 10 days to return standard items.
Oh, really? So it's not too late? I can send it back?

That's correct. You're well within the return window. Your safety is our priority, and we want you to be completely happy with your gear. Since the box is unopened, I can process this return for you right now.
Wow, thank you so much! That's such a relief. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you, Alex!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
